title: Disable MPO Overlay
name: disable-mpo-overlay
modal: This disables Multiplane Overlay in the display driver. It fixes stutter and flicker on many NVIDIA and AMD setups.
description: Disables driver multiplane overlay to fix stutter, flicker and tearing in games
deepDescription:
Multiplane Overlay (MPO) offloads window composition to the display driver, but on many drivers it causes stutter, flicker and alt-tab issues. This disables it:

- OverlayTestMode → 5 (MPO off)

Revert deletes the value. Restart recommended.
